title: Technical talk on 'Interpretation of eigenvalues and eigen vectors in real world applications'
summary: This talk was conducted by Dr. Parakrama Ekanayaka from the Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, University of Peradeniya. The talk focused on how eigenvalues and eigenvectors make sense in real engineering applications.
